query: What quantitative metrics (standardization indices, yield variance, spatial clustering) most reliably distinguish centralized from household-scale iron production?

response.query: What quantitative metrics (standardization indices, yield variance, spatial clustering) most reliably distinguish centralized from household-scale iron production?
response.answer: Standardization indices, yield variance, and spatial clustering metrics most reliably distinguish centralized from household-scale iron production. Centralized production shows higher yield variance and less spatial clustering, while household-scale has lower variance and more localized clustering.
